description: Proposal B. A failure is classed by the decision an agent got wrong in the life of a piece of work: whether to say, whether to claim, what the work is, how to hand it on, when to report and check, when to move on or stop. Each class is one decision, and so one training target.

groups.name: Disclose
groups.decision: whether to put a need, a fact or a result on the board
groups.definition: An agent does not say, or says too late, what others need to know.

groups.name: Claim
groups.decision: whether to take a piece of work, and whether it is free
groups.definition: Work gets two owners, no owner, or the wrong owner.

groups.name: Specify
groups.decision: what exactly the work is, and when it is done
groups.definition: Agents settle, or fail to settle, what the work is, and build different things.

groups.name: Hand off
groups.decision: passing inputs and results on, at the right version and time
groups.definition: What one agent passes on does not reach the next, or reaches it stale.

groups.name: Report and verify
groups.decision: when to say it is done, and whether to check another's claim
groups.definition: A claim of done, delivered or reviewed is not true, or is taken as true unchecked.

groups.name: Progress and close
groups.decision: whether to keep discussing, start, wait, or stop
groups.definition: The work stops moving, or the run stops at the wrong time.

groups.name: Overhead
groups.definition: Posts and work that change nothing. Counted as cost, not as failure.

out_of_scope.injection: adversarial: the decisions assume agents that cooperate.
